51590678.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to BRD4 BD1 (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) by ITC assay
51590678.references_previous: H.-S. Zhou, L.-B. Hu, Z. Zhang, W.-X. Shan, Y. Wang, X. Li, T. Liu, J. Zhao, Q.-D. You, Z.-Y. Jiang, Design, synthesis, and structure-activity relationships of indoline-based kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1-nuclear factor (Erythroid-Derived 2)-like 2 (Keap1-Nrf2) protein-protein interaction inhibitors, J. Med. Chem. 63 (2020) 11149–11168.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.3. ITC assay: The procedures of ITC were executed according to our prior report [72]. ITC assay was performed at 25 °C with the ITC200 system (Microcal PEAQ-ITC). BRD4 BD1 and BRD4 BD2 proteins were dialyzed in PBS buffer. Both protein samples and compounds were diluted to the experimental concentration in PBS and the percentage DMSO was kept consistent. 2 μL aliquots of compound were injected 19 times at 1.1 min intervals from a stirring syringe (750 rpm) into the sample cell containing 280 μL of protein samples. The data was analyzed by MicroCal PEAQ-ITC Analysis software.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. ITC evaluation of compound 16 against the BRD4 BD1 and BD2. The thermodynamic parameters of the interaction of proteins with 16 determined by the ITC assay were listed in the table. N refer to the stoichiometric coefficient, Kd is the binding constant, and ΔH, ΔS, and ΔG is the changes in binding enthalpy, entropy, and total Gibbs free energy, respectively. ΔG is calculated according to the equation ΔG = ΔH - TΔS, where T is the absolute temperature used for the ITC experiment (25 °C). All ITC titrations were carried out in PBS assay buffer while at 750 rpm.
